headline: Get Erlath
title: How to Get Erlath | The Final Water Form | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Erlath is a Water Aniimo you get by evolving Fahloo, and the line has no branches. Raise your Fahloo to level forty nine and it becomes Erlath. You can also catch Erlath in the wild on Tideblossom Coast, where it appears around levels fifty three to sixty. Erlath is the end of the line, so there is nothing further to unlock. Do you run Erlath on your team? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Wild levels fifty three to sixty

description: Aniimo's Erlath evolves from Fahloo at level 49 or can be caught in the wild on Tideblossom Coast at roughly levels 53 to 60. It is the final form of its line.
